scripts.dev: concurrently -n middleware,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev -w middleware" "npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run dev & sleep 3 && npm run start -w electron
scripts.build: npm run build -w ui && npm run build -w electron
scripts.startall: concurrently -n engine,middleware,ui,electron -c red,blue,green,cyan "cmd /c engine\\build\\Debug\\trading-engine.exe" "npm run start -w middleware" "npm run dev -w ui" "cmd /c timeout /t 3 /nobreak && npm run start -w electron"
